description.fallback: In the jeep, Kakyoin and Polnareff discuss how they can defeat Hanged Man and whether a world in the mirror really exists. In the middle of the conversation, Kakyoin notices Hanged Man inside a metal part of the steering wheel. He hits the brakes to avoid the Stand, and the jeep flips over.

text.fallback: Head out: Emperor and Hanged Man, Part 5

outro.fallback: Since he can now predict Hanged Man's trajectory, Polnareff easily cuts the Stand before it manages to enter his eye.
Geil screaming at a distance and swear to avenge both Avdol and Chérie.
